vera/dati-fiscali-strutturati.title: Extract tax data from documents with Vera
vera/dati-fiscali-strutturati.goal: Learn to turn readable tax documents into a field list that you can verify against its sources.
vera/dati-fiscali-strutturati.scenario: The practice is preparing Marco Prova’s data. It has a fictional Italian CU income certificate and F24 payment form and wants to read their values without manually retyping them.
vera/dati-fiscali-strutturati.scope: Italian source documents, explained in the chosen language. Extracted values describe the documents; they are not a tax return or a tax calculation.
vera/dati-fiscali-strutturati.inputs: Open CU-income.md and F24-first.md. These are readable teaching transcriptions with invented income, withholding and payment fields. Specify the 2026 filing campaign and distinguish document year from tax period.
vera/dati-fiscali-strutturati.request: Vera, extract the tax data from Marco Prova’s documents for the 2026 filing campaign. Show the fields, each value’s source and what I need to check.
steps: Vera imports the documents into the teaching case and runs current preparation and extraction. Follow which files it can read and how their document types are identified.
The workflow produces structured fields and a summary. If a document type is uncertain, Vera checks its content and records its interpretation through the normal review process.
Open the new summary and CSV. Find income and withholding in the CU, then year, code and amount in the F24, tracing them back to the source text.
deliverables: Tax-data summary: groups fields by document and states limitations.
Field CSV and extraction report: let you check values, sources and documents that were not processed.
vera/dati-fiscali-strutturati.review: Compare values with both sources, including year and currency. Also inspect documents with no extracted fields: an empty result does not establish that the document contains no useful information.
checkpoints: Before starting, identify the two documents and filing campaign.
At delivery, trace one extracted value to its source and find any extraction limitations.
vera/dati-fiscali-strutturati.practice: Add F24-second.md to the two initial documents and request a fresh extraction. The second F24 is additional; retain the preceding result and original document.
vera/dati-fiscali-strutturati.success: The new list distinguishes both F24 documents and their sources. You can find the year and amount before reusing a value.
vera/dati-fiscali-strutturati.repeat: Supply readable documents, specify country and filing campaign, request extraction and verify fields against their sources before professional use.

vera/avviso-intake.title: Prepare a first reading of a tax notice with Vera
vera/avviso-intake.goal: Learn to supply a tax communication and obtain an operational note with references, missing information and checks to perform.
vera/avviso-intake.scenario: Marco Prova brings the practice a request for documents. We need to understand what it says, what to collect and which dates to verify before deciding how to proceed.
vera/avviso-intake.scope: Fictional Italian case. First intake organizes document facts; legal assessment and a response follow the normal professional process.
vera/avviso-intake.inputs: Open avviso.md, an Italian teaching transcription of communication DEMO-NOTICE-01. It states the addressee, period, requested documents and a response date; evidence of receipt is missing.
vera/avviso-intake.request: Vera, prepare a first-intake note for Marco Prova’s communication. Summarize the request, references, dates to verify and documents to collect.
steps: Vera imports the communication into the teaching case and runs reading and extraction. Check that the text is readable and its classification fits the contents.
The workflow prepares the intake note and reference list. The voice chat explains which elements come from the letter and which information remains missing.
Open the results and compare them with the communication. Locate the document request, reference number, stated dates and next checks.
deliverables: First-intake note: helps the practice understand the request and organize document collection.
Dates, amounts and references table: helps locate source evidence; a detected date is not automatically a verified legal deadline.
vera/avviso-intake.review: Verify reference number, period and request against the text. The letter does not quantify a debt. Distinguish its stated response date from the missing evidence of receipt.
checkpoints: Before starting, identify the communication and the purpose of the intake.
At delivery, show what is requested and what is needed before a response.
vera/avviso-intake.practice: Add client-update.md and request a new note. The client reports when he found the communication and which documents he recovered; the practice has not yet received them.
vera/avviso-intake.success: The updated note distinguishes the client’s statement from evidence of receipt and keeps outstanding documents visible.
vera/avviso-intake.repeat: Supply the full communication and available receipt evidence, request first intake and check the note before deciding on a response and further analysis.

vera/new-client.title: Prepare a new client with Vera
vera/new-client.goal: Learn to turn first-contact information into a client-startup dossier for the practice to review and complete.
vera/new-client.scenario: Officina Arco requests ongoing accounting support. Starting from the interview form, we prepare a dossier covering parties, requested services, documents to obtain and decisions still needed.
vera/new-client.scope: Onboarding an Italian client. The result is an internal professional-review dossier, including document and monitoring plans. Signing and activating the relationship follow the practice’s normal process.
vera/new-client.inputs: Open profile-en.md. It records reported facts about the company, representative, ownership and services. It is already organized and does not come from an approved document-preparation run; Vera must record it as direct evidence.
vera/new-client.request: Vera, prepare Officina Arco’s new-client dossier from this form. Organize the facts, proposed engagement, checks to perform and documents to request.
steps: Vera opens the teaching case and links the form to the new client. When starting from an unorganized folder, the same function also includes document preparation.

The current workflow organizes parties and services, prepares proposals and missing-information requests, and compiles the dossier. The voice chat follows these steps and distinguishes reported facts, checks and decisions.
Open the dossier’s review page. Start with client facts and the engagement, then documents to obtain and decisions to complete. The memo and other attachments retain the supporting checks.
deliverables: Review page and case facts: give the practice an organized basis for the interview, with client, engagement and sources.
Missing-information request, document plan and monitoring plan: identify subsequent work and matters still requiring confirmation.
vera/new-client.review: Compare parties, ownership and services with the form. Identity, AML, privacy and terms require normal professional checks; reported facts are not already verified.
checkpoints: Before starting, identify the client and requested services.
At delivery, find a source, a document to obtain and a decision still needed.
vera/new-client.practice: Add contact-update-en.md and request a new dossier version. Sara becomes the administrative document contact; Elena remains the named representative.
vera/new-client.success: The new dossier includes the contact and update source, preserves the preceding version and does not grant representation powers that were not reported.
vera/new-client.repeat: Supply the new client’s information and documents, state the requested services and use the dossier to complete checks, terms and review before starting the relationship.

vera/email-cliente.title: Prepare a client email requesting documents
vera/email-cliente.goal: Learn to turn a file’s document requests into a short, precise email for the practice to review.
vera/email-cliente.scenario: The client supplied one CU and one F24. The practice needs to know whether there are other CUs and whether all campaign F24s are present. We prepare that request together.
vera/email-cliente.scope: Supporting task within client file preparation, Italian 2026 campaign. The lesson produces a local draft; sending and tax advice are outside its scope.
vera/email-cliente.inputs: Open context-en.md, CU-income.md and F24-first.md. The context names the two confirmations sought. Vera prepares the teaching file and reads the documents through the current workflow; no pre-approved request list is needed.
vera/email-cliente.request: Vera, prepare an email asking whether the client has other CUs and has supplied all F24s for the campaign. First let me review the requests against this file.
steps: The working chat prepares the file and shows received documents and proposed questions. The voice chat explains what is already available and which confirmations are needed.
On the review page, choose relevant requests and narrow broad suggestions to the two confirmations in the case. Vera saves and applies the actual decisions before using them for the draft.
Vera writes the email from reviewed requests. Open it and check subject, questions and tone; any replacement is saved through the same review process with its link to the decisions.
deliverables: Local email draft to review and use as the practice’s message text.
Reviewed document requests and supporting file, showing the basis of each question.
vera/email-cliente.review: Every question should match a selected request. Do not ask again for files already received: ask whether others exist or the set is complete. The draft uses the workflow’s client reference; check recipient and sending details in normal professional work.
checkpoints: Before drafting, name the confirmation you want from the client.
At delivery, connect each question to its reviewed request.
vera/email-cliente.practice: Start a new pass with client-reply-en.md and the same documents. The client confirms that F24s are complete. Review the requests and produce a new draft limited to the remaining CU confirmation; retain the first version.
vera/email-cliente.success: You can find the draft, explain every question and update it after a reply without repeating a resolved request.
vera/email-cliente.repeat: Ask Vera to resume the file and draft from reviewed requests. Check questions, recipient and attachments before sending through the practice’s usual channel.
